description.zh:
动作名称。取值范围：
- start：启动。
- stop：停止。
- config：下发配置。
- restart：重启 。
- refresh_queues：刷新YARN队列。
- refresh_labels：刷新YARN标签。
- refresh_nodes:  刷新 YARN 集群中节点信息。
description.en:
The name of the action. Valid values:

- start

- stop

- config

- restart

- refresh\_queues

- refresh\_labels
The number of applications in each batch.

description.zh:
运行策略。取值范围：
- FAILED_BLOCK：失败后阻塞。
- FAILED_CONTINUE：失败后继续。
description.en:
The execution policy. Valid values:

- FAILED\_BLOCK: The system stops the execution if the execution fails.

- FAILED\_CONTINUE: The system continues the execution if the execution fails.

description.zh: 滚动执行间隔时间。单位：秒。
description.en: The interval for rolling execution. Unit: seconds.
Specifies whether to enable rolling execution.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr run-application-action --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id C-C95F0A39D8FF0000 --action-name start --component-instance-selector example-string --rolling-execute true --execute-strategy FAILED_CONTINUE --interval 10 --batch-size 1 --description Running_description --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun emr RunApplicationAction --region cn-hangzhou --ActionName start --BatchSize 1 --Description Running_description --ClusterId 'C-C95F0A39D8FF0000' --ComponentInstanceSelector 'example-string' --RollingExecute true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ExecuteStrategy FAILED_CONTINUE --Interval 10 --method POST --force
